flannel.songTitle: A Nervous Tic Motion of the Head to the Left
flannel.line: Barely alive we cover the blisters in flannel
stanza: Barely alive we cover the blisters in flannel
Though the words we speak are banal
Not one of them's a lie
Not one of them's a lie
You're what happens when two substances collide
And by all accounts you really should have died
